title: session.state@2
description: A session's state as every surface names it, the one reading deep status lists (#992), appended by the core when it changes: the state's word and why, from a closed set. A minor of session.state@1 (#2018): the first matching row of the one ordered state table, so a claim's verdict is a state too. It is read from the record and is never evidence.

subject.description: The session this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

state.description: The word every surface names the session's state with.

x-closure.closed: the states deep status lists, each a word on every surface
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a state deep status lists

cause.description: Why: an open ask, its agent's process gone mid-turn, a prompt of its agent's waiting on you, words of yours whose delivery stalled or timed out, a block only you or a service can clear, a promised check due, a turn ended failed, its newest claim sent back, judged BLOCKED, INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE, judged on a commit that has moved, or not judged yet, a turn at work, a task not started, its newest claim's PASS, a turn you interrupted, a turn stopped, or its hooks gone quiet.

x-closure.closed: the reasons the one reading gives a state
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a reason
